scale: Qualitative pre-deployment assessment; no quantitative exploitation forecast
acceptanceAuthority: operator with evidence; package generation does not accept unresolved production risk

risks.scenario: Accidental public evidence in repository/static webroot/image
risks.mitigation: Separate private runtime and authenticated fixed routes; inspect staged diff and image
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Never deploy private payload through public source/artifacts

risks.scenario: Unauthorized access via guessed document/text/range/HEAD routes
risks.mitigation: Authentication before every evidence byte and default deny
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Run all negative route tests and live smoke checks

risks.scenario: Direct origin or forged trusted headers bypass ingress
risks.mitigation: Secret edge key, exact Host/proto, loopback publication, overwritten headers
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Verify live ingress, firewall and absent public upstream

risks.scenario: Same-origin XSS or compromised scripts on existing website
risks.mitigation: Portal CSP and closed content surface; whole-origin audit required
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Existing repository/scripts/dependencies unavailable; review before launch

risks.scenario: Existing root-scoped service worker intercepts or caches evidence
risks.mitigation: No new service worker, no-store, explicit scope inspection
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Remove/restrict any covering worker and check actual registrations before launch

risks.scenario: Stolen/shared credentials or recipient device compromise
risks.mitigation: Named accounts, strong passwords, short expiry, revocation
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Share privately; review recipient need; copies cannot be revoked

risks.scenario: Password guessing or global lockout of legitimate readers
risks.mitigation: Scrypt plus per-IP/account/global limits and hashing concurrency bound
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Observe owned deployment rate behavior and provide access help

risks.scenario: Stale sessions after account changes or multiple instances
risks.mitigation: Change the operator-owned source accounts and redeploy a new read-only installed snapshot; memory-only sessions are revoked on recreation/restart
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Use one instance; source edits plus restart of the old snapshot do not copy account changes, and restart alone allows still-enabled accounts to sign in. Stop urgently before updating/redeploying; replicas need redesign. Rollback/restore must preserve the latest approved disabled/expiry state; changed-account deployment failure must not automatically reactivate an older snapshot.

risks.scenario: Cross-site request forgery/login CSRF
risks.mitigation: Origin checks and one-use/session-bound proofs
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Test malformed/missing/duplicate and expired proofs

risks.scenario: CDN/proxy cache, search/referrer or browser download exposure
risks.mitigation: No-store, noindex, no-referrer, no public listing
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Disable edge cache and inspect live headers; downloads remain recipient-controlled

risks.scenario: Traversal/smuggling/parser disagreement
risks.mitigation: Fixed IDs, ambiguous-path/duplicate-boundary-header rejection, limits
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Maintain proxy/runtime and test actual ingress parsing

risks.scenario: Denial of service or excessive password/PDF resource use
risks.mitigation: Bounded forms, sessions/preauth/rate maps, hashing, connections and container resources
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Ingress/host capacity and internet-scale DoS remain outside bounded tests

risks.scenario: Unknown runtime/image/host/proxy vulnerability
risks.mitigation: Small no-npm service, digest pin, reduced privileges and patch/revalidation policy
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Review real digest/advisories; no zero-day elimination claim

risks.scenario: Original PDF contains malicious content
risks.mitigation: Exact authenticated bytes; no server-side PDF execution/parsing
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Hash identity is not document safety; maintained viewer/source assessment needed

risks.scenario: Secrets/private data leak in host/proxy logs/backups
risks.mitigation: Allowlisted audit schema with stable private domain-separated HMAC account pseudonyms and opaque document-response metadata; no intended token/filename/content logging; encrypted protected backups
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Inspect host/proxy logs and retention, protect linkable pseudonym/source-hash metadata, record rotation correlation boundary and perform restore/custody review

risks.scenario: Loss of source or failed rollback/restore
risks.mitigation: Immutable source/manifests, known-good image-content pair and isolated encrypted backup; installer disables automatic fallback when approved account or edge-key state changes
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Target-host clean restore exercise pending. Reconcile latest account revocations/expiry and current ingress key before starting a restored/rolled-back code-content pair; historical credential/key snapshots must not undo revocation. Reconcile actual container and release pointer after an interrupted deployment.

risks.scenario: Reviewer blocked by accessibility or enterprise browser/network friction
risks.mitigation: Labels, keyboard/text/PDF support and documented assistance
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Target-environment keyboard/assistive-technology/PDF check pending

risks.scenario: Assuming per-team privacy when account grants whole dossier
risks.mitigation: Whole-dossier scope explicitly documented; restricted financial originals excluded
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: Operator approves included bundle for every enabled reviewer before provisioning

risks.scenario: Mistaking HTTP access for official receipt/acceptance or legal effect
risks.mitigation: RECORD_REQUESTED and DOCUMENT_RESPONSE_SENT on server finish are bounded operational events; no client-read, identity, official-receipt or decision assertion
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: HEAD records zero body bytes and ranges record partial response bytes; neither server finish nor accumulated events prove a complete client download, reading, official receipt, consideration, acceptance or record linkage

risks.scenario: Future AI/upload/tool feature expands attack surface silently
risks.mitigation: Closed capability policy and no such routes
risks.requiredActionOrResidual: New threat model, dependencies, permissions, isolation and tests before policy change
